commit_message: chore(governance): review PR 1128 LLM boundary candidates

llm-boundary:004797cc6f7b6e3154e4906d.rationale: collect_git_workspace validates caller-supplied Git SHAs, a canonical diff hash, bounded paths and an explicit clean-state boolean to build read-only evidence; it does not infer user intent or authorize effects.

llm-boundary:c8705fd9731ec686d7149243.rationale: collect_github_ci compares exact GitHub run, check, conclusion and revision identifiers to construct read-only CI evidence; it does not interpret free language or authorize workflow mutations.

llm-boundary:c964c12fda9cc638c8c34b31.rationale: collect_github_ci compares a fixed conclusion enum and exact workflow and head SHAs to detect stale structured evidence; it does not infer semantic intent or authorize execution.

llm-boundary:f2f9e19a6dbc146874576101.rationale: collect_provider compares explicit route-health booleans, a revision and a SHA-256 truth-boundary identifier to build read-only provider evidence; it does not interpret free language or select or authorize a provider effect.
